statistics_policy: No benchmark or analyzer was rerun and no statistical thresholds, cohort or source observations were changed. Endpoint estimates and qualifications below are retained from the registered comparison; raw provenance/output/cache/operating contracts were checked independently.
operational_checks: 12 complete zero-exit receipts and exact registered commands/protocol/artifact before-after maps
96 fixed request-body hashes and full assistant-text hashes/counts/finish reasons
12 distinct stable native server PIDs with nominated build/model/layout/width/KV/state/ANE/context identities
Raw AC/thermal/no-swap measurement observations plus recorded operating gates
All cold matched_tokens=0 and all warm matched_tokens>0
All server shutdowns exit 0 with no owned processes left running
artifact_scope: Recorded receipt/driver before-after artifact identities match the frozen nomination. This audit does not rerun the runtime or rehash large native bundles/model weights.
response_hash_encoding: canonical_record_sha256 hashes each retained per-request record as UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no ASCII escaping and compact separators; http_result_sha256 hashes original result.json bytes. These are retained HTTP response records, not original wire bytes or native token arrays.
completion_scope: All 96 responses reach their fixed 64/128/192/256-token caps; each four-request phase returns 640 tokens; all finish reasons are length.
http_output_scope: Full assistant text, completion count and finish reason. The HTTP API does not expose native output-token arrays.
own_case_scope: Per-case qualifications apply their own preregistered output/cache/noise/effect gates. Other concurrent cases fail output identity; surviving own-case endpoints therefore do not establish a clean whole-workload substitution or a universally fastest serving default.
causal_scope: The causes of deterministic cross-arm and cold/warm text changes are not isolated. These observations do not prove recurrence of the historical 8193 boundary issue, do not establish an M48/QKV regression, and do not show cache-equivalent outputs.
